summary: Comprehensive testing of Audiophile Music Player with glassmorphism UI. Backend: 19/19 tests passed. Frontend: All major features working correctly. 24 songs seeded, 10 EQ presets, AI search and analysis functional. All 5 tabs with unique accent colors rendering correctly.

issues: React Native deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents)
Expo Router warning: Route '+html' is extraneous in layout children

action_items: Consider updating shadow props to use boxShadow syntax to remove deprecation warnings
Remove or properly configure '+html' route in _layout.tsx to eliminate Expo Router warning
critical_code_review_comments: ✓ All backend endpoints properly exclude MongoDB _id field
✓ Environment variables correctly used (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, MONGO_URL, EMERGENT_LLM_KEY)
✓ Proper React Native components used (View, Text, TouchableOpacity, etc.)
✓ All interactive elements have testID attributes for testing
✓ Glassmorphism UI implemented correctly with per-tab accent colors
✓ AI integration (OpenAI GPT-4o-mini) working via emergentintegrations
✓ MongoDB aggregation pipelines for artists/genres working correctly
✓ PlayerContext properly manages playback state with refs to avoid stale closures
✓ All 24 songs seeded with diverse formats (FLAC, DSD, WAV, AIFF, MP3, AAC, OGG, WMA)
seed_data_creation: Backend automatically seeds 24 demo songs, 10 EQ presets, and default audio settings on startup. Test playlist created during testing.
